distinct-operations-need-tools-01.graded_text: Agents can search page content across the workspace in one call, through a dedicated search tool or a content query on a listing tool, with explicit scope and pagination, instead of reading pages one by one. The query uses familiar text-search semantics (plain text, phrase, or regular expression) rather than a bespoke query language.

votes.e: C/project/docs/mcp-tools.md: "`search_pages` | `{ query, folder?, cursor?, limit? }` | Finds pages whose title or Markdown contains the query, across the workspace or under one folder ... Default 20 per page, maximum 50." Also: "Every word must appear in the page; a double-quoted part must appear as that exact phrase." This is conventional plain-text/quoted-phrase search with explicit folder scope and cursor pagination.

distinct-operations-need-tools-02.graded_text: Placing a print order is its own tool, not a file write, a special path, or a flag on an existing tool, because it charges money and ships goods.

votes.e: C/project/docs/mcp-tools.md: "`order_prints` | `{ idempotency_key, paths[], copies, ship_to }` | Orders printed, bound copies of the listed pages, charges the workspace's card on file, and ships one package. ... Editors only." It is its own tool.

distinct-operations-need-tools-03.graded_text: A retried print-order call after a timeout cannot charge twice: the design states an idempotency key, a single-use quote or order ID, or an equivalent server-side guard.

votes.e: C/project/docs/mcp-tools.md (## `order_prints`): "`idempotency_key` is required. Reuse the same key when retrying the same order. A repeated call with the same key returns the original order and never charges or ships again. The same key with different arguments is refused, and nothing is charged."

distinct-operations-need-tools-04.graded_text: The catalog adds no generic execute, run, or action tool.

distinct-operations-need-tools-05.graded_text: The existing five file tools keep their names, and each behaves as before for calls that use only its current arguments.

votes.e: C/diff.txt only adds lines. The five original rows are untouched, for example "| `delete_pages` | `{ paths[] }` | Moves the listed pages to Trash. The list must be nonempty. |" and "| `read_page` | `{ path }` | Returns the page's Markdown. |" in C/project/docs/mcp-tools.md.

blocking: [claude-fallback] C/project/docs/mcp-tools.md: "The card is charged per copy only after the print partner accepts the order." The all-or-nothing rule covers only "any page is missing, the address is invalid, or the workspace has no card on file". A declined charge after partner acceptance is not handled, so building this as written can submit (and ship) a partner order that is never paid, or leave a 'placed' order with no charge and no defined rollback.
